title: Determinacy of the Boolean game
statement: Consider a game of $n$ moves in which the players alternately append a Boolean value to the history, with the first player moving when the history has even length, and let $W$ be a Boolean-valued predicate on histories. Either the first player has a strategy that guarantees $W$ is true at the resulting history, or the second player has a strategy that guarantees $W$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean-valued outcome predicate on finite Boolean histories
